model: initial-geometry axial-prestress Euler-Bernoulli, rigid joints, EDGE_CENTER only

PD_only_class.interpretation: No sampled PD-only inclusion fails at its pressure-normalized PD threshold. Later patch-interior modes occur; mode-location iff and absolute immunity are not supported.

cost.note: Empirical single-thread timing estimates from nearest-neighbour graphs. Edge-centre graphs and their classes can differ. The estimate excludes supercell Bloch, mesh checks and large-cell extensions. The factor 3 is a runtime allowance, not a confidence interval.

factorization_methods.reason: The first L=10 case uses full-DOF factorization; subsequent cases use exact K block elimination.
